meta.bt_team: Team rows tested on every game 2018-19 to 2025-26, each judged only on games before it: teams 8-2+ ATS in their last 10 went 1,979-1,976 (-5.4%); 15-5+ in their last 20 679-679 (-5.1%); 70%+ in today's role 1,487-1,551 (-7.7%); 2-8 or worse 1,984-1,881 (-2.9%) the next game at closing prices. Team ATS streaks are noise against the closing line.
meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2020-21 to 2025-26, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 2,305-2,311 (49.9%, -5.6% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 439-417 (51.3%, -3.0% return); the first line alone, 1,479-1,438 (50.7%, -4.1% return). Totals the same way: 209-190 (52.4%, -1.0% return). Graded at each game's closing price: these trends have not beaten the closing line on games they never saw. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: League row out of sample (2020-21 to 2025-26, each season judged on the two seasons before it): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 1,479-1,438 (50.7%, -4.1% return), lost against the closing line.
meta.bt_held: None of the 42 spots the rule bet made money in 3+ later seasons with p < .05.
